# lookup alias has problem

Fix `lookup` for shell aliases:

```bash
$ lookup run
alias run=./Taskfile not found
$ echo $?
1
```

`lookup` ([#40](DOT-39.md)) resolves its argument with `command -v`; for an alias that returns the text `alias run=./Taskfile`, which is not a file, so the fallback `which "$target"` was fed that whole string and reported "not found" — the alias body was in fact found, but shown as an error.

Expected: `lookup <alias>` prints the alias definition and exits 0.
